name: New Rainbow Fabrics
old_description: New Rainbow Fabrics was established in 2007 with one mission: to bring a real, high quality Fabric Store to the Chicago area. Our passion for excellence is what inspired us in the beginning and it continues to drive us today. We pride ourselves in the superior experience of shopping in our Fabric Store and in the long-term relationships we’ve built with our customers. People come back to New Rainbow Fabrics because they know they’ll find what they’re looking for on our shelves - and if they don’t, we’ll help them find it. Stop by and see for yourself!
about:
New Rainbow Fabrics opened in 2007 in Chicago, Illinois, with a stated mission to bring a genuine, high‑quality fabric store to the area. The business was founded as a retail destination for fabrics, though the founders are not named in available sources and no ownership designation (family, veteran, woman‑owned, etc.) is disclosed.

The company operates a single brick‑and‑mortar fabric store. Its primary activity is retail sales of fabrics and related notions; no manufacturing, fabrication, or industrial processes are described. The location keeps regular hours six days a week, with reduced hours on Sunday. Facility size, headcount, inventory volume, and SKU count are not provided.

The store serves retail customers in the Chicago metropolitan area, including sewists, quilters, apparel makers, and home‑decor enthusiasts. The website notes that shoppers return because they can find what they need on the shelves, and staff assist in locating items not immediately in stock.

The company emphasizes a passion for excellence and a superior in‑store shopping experience. It highlights long‑term customer relationships and a willingness to help patrons source fabrics that are not currently carried, positioning personal service as its key differentiator.
